#!/bin/bash

# Install packages
install_pkgs() {
  # Official
  local OFFICIAL=.official_pkgs.txt
  local NF_PKGS=$(wc -l <$OFFICIAL)

  # AUR
  local AUR=.aur_pkgs.txt
  while read -r pkg; do
    sleep 0.2
  done <"$OFFICIAL"

  echo -e "[+] Official packages installed"

  while read -r pkg; do
    echo $pkg >/dev/null
  done <"$AUR"

  echo "[+] AUR packages installed"
}

# Spiner
spiner() {
  local PID=$1
  local DELAY=0.1
  local SPIN='|/-\'
  echo -n "[+] Wait :) "
  tput civis
  while [ "$(ps a | awk '{print $1}' | grep $PID)" ]; do
    local temp=${SPIN#?}
    printf " [%c]  " "$SPIN"
    local SPIN=$temp${SPIN%"$temp"}
    sleep $DELAY
    printf "\b\b\b\b\b\b"
    printf "    \b\b\b\b"
  done
  tput cnorm
}

# Clean cursor
clean_cursor() {
  tput cnorm
  echo -e "\n[+] Exit signal detected..."
  exit
}

# MAIN FUNCTION
main() {
  echo -e " "
  if ! uname -r | grep "cachy" >/dev/null; then
    echo -e "\n[+] This script is designed for CachyOS, it's not recommend use in other distros because is not completly tested. Conflicts with some critical system packages are likely."
    exit 1
  else
    echo "[+] Correct distro detected: CachyOS"
  fi

  echo "[+] The necessary packages will be installed from both the official repository and AUR. If the AUR is not installed, it will be installed..."

  if ! which "yay" >/dev/null; then
    pacman -S yay
  fi

  install_pkgs &
  spiner $!
}

# EXECUTION
trap clean_cursor EXIT INT
main

#!/bin/bash

# Función para el spinner
spinner() {
    local pid=$1
    local delay=0.1
    local spinstr='|/-\'
    echo -n "Instalando paquetes... "
    
    # Mientras el proceso ($pid) siga vivo...
    while [ "$(ps -p $pid -o state=)" ]; do
        local temp=${spinstr#?}
        printf " [%c]  " "$spinstr"
        local spinstr=$temp${spinstr%"$temp"}
        sleep $delay
        printf "\b\b\b\b\b\b" # Borra los caracteres para el siguiente giro
    done
    printf "    \b\b\b\b"
    echo "¡Hecho!"
}

# --- EJECUCIÓN ---

# 1. Lanzamos la instalación en segundo plano
# Redirigimos la salida a un log para que no rompa la animación
sudo pacman -S --noconfirm git > /tmp/install.log 2>&1 &

# 2. Guardamos el PID del comando anterior
INSTALL_PID=$!

# 3. Llamamos al spinner pasándole el PID
spinner $INSTALL_PID

echo "[+] Proceso finalizado correctamente."
